payload.title: Briefing: Check for Updates Synchronization Mechanism
payload.summary: The Estate now has an implemented Check for Updates mechanism. This is intended to let office occupants and workers synchronize with relevant institutional changes without repeating full onboarding.
context_for_ca4: Check for Updates is not onboarding. It is an incremental synchronization command.
The command is actor-aware and can generate different update briefings for Chief Architects, Alfred, Audit, Implementation/Codex, Documentation, Discovery, Steward, or General actors.
The feature should become part of the standard pre-work rhythm for long-lived personnel, especially Chief Architects before architectural review.
The current visibility model is temporary and must not be treated as final security clearance policy.
requested_ca4_review: Review whether the command provides sufficient synchronization context for newly activated or long-lived Chief Architects.
Evaluate whether Chief Architects should be expected to run Check for Updates before performing architectural review.
Review mailbox-aware assigned message behavior and recommend any refinements after use.
Confirm whether the feature should remain Operational Validation Pending until used by multiple employee classes.
recommended_usage: Before architectural work, run or request Check for Updates for your actor identity.
Review assigned messages and relevant architectural/governance/collaboration updates.
Reply through the Communication Bus where the response should become institutional memory.
